learning_units.description: Maintain belt-hold (zonaria) alignment and bent-knee posture while transitioning to fast tempo.

social_formats.description: Line dance led from the right with dancers holding neighboring belts; optional inner line formation.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands firmly hold the adjacent dancers' belts (zonaria).
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Line dance led from the right. Can form an inner belt-hold line towards the center, or feature coiling/uncoiling patterns.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low level maintained via continuously bent knees; jumps not described in sources.
movement_profile.partnering: Belt-hold connection with neighboring dancers on either side in a shared line.
movement_profile.posture: Continuous bent-knee posture maintained throughout, becoming especially evident during the fast tsestos section.

signature_moves.description: Holding the belt of the adjacent dancer on each side throughout the movement.
signature_moves.name: Zonaria hold

signature_moves.description: Forming a secondary fast line inside towards the center of the original dance line.
signature_moves.name: Inner belt-hold line

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Accelerates from a steady walking pace into a fast, energetic speed.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid straightening the knees or letting go of neighboring belts during speed transitions.

music_profile.musical_form: Transitions from a steady Zonaradiko section into an accelerated, fast Tsestos section.

basic_steps: Grasp the belts (zonaria) of adjacent dancers on the left and right.
Bend both knees deeply to maintain a low center of gravity throughout.
Follow the leader on the right side of the line in step with the Thracian rhythm.
Accelerate footwork speed while maintaining belt-hold as the transition to fast tsestos occurs.
teaching.formation: Line dance with dancers holding adjacent belts (zonaria); leader positioned on the right.
teaching.level_notes: Requires strong leg stamina due to continuous bent-knee posture during fast tempo transitions.
